title: Conditional κ = 0.001676855229071321886144: finer 1e-24 kappa grid on PR1319's 74-replica exact-fill construction (same construction, only the final grid is refined)
body:
## Summary

The strict outer assembler's final kappa grid is refined from 1e-18 to 1e-24 (the three grid expressions in code/assemble.py, as in the merged PR1019). With the same exact margin the 47 strict outer inequalities hold at the finer floor and the next grid point is rejected, so kappa moves from 0.001676855229071321 to 0.001676855229071321886144. No construction improvement is claimed.
